failure_patterns.pattern: tool_result_persistence: A result-producing search or filter was left unsaved, or cache retrieval was nested inside another tool call.

rejected_edits.content: `search_attractions` also requires at least one of `city` or `state`, even though each field is individually optional in the schema. Use an established trip or destination location when applicable; if neither is known, seek it rather than calling the search without a location.

For both `search_flights` and `filter_flights`, use the supported lowercase `flight_class` labels `business`, `economy`, or `first` (for example, “business class” maps to `["business"]`); do not title-case these values.
rejected_edits.target: If the user says the trip is one-way or explicitly declines a return flight, search only the outbound leg.

rejected_edits.content: A hotel fitness center or gym maps to `gym_present=True`; use `has_fitness_class=True` only when the user asks for fitness classes.
rejected_edits.target: Do not map vague amenity wording to a narrower tool flag without clear equivalence.
